name: Mira Goepe
source:
22 years old. She is called by "Ice-cold Goepe". Chief of the UHOS Secret Police. Once she was a gentle school teacher, but was brainwashed and turned into ruthless soldier. Personally commanded a many repressive operations and shredded the data of an all families members whereabouts.

[spoiler]Took command for the final stage of sharism revolution in Japan plan, but ran away after considered it a failure. With the Red Stone's curse broken she tried to kill Katerine, but failed and was thrown into Space in Rescue Bot. Has been saved by Japan and after the fall of UHOS trying to live with her former pupils, Katerine and Milya.[/spoiler]

"All for the equality of humanity!"
